READ & UNDERSTAND

The seed in the tin.

Lebo found an empty tin beside the door. With an adult’s help, she filled it with soil and planted a bean. Every morning she checked the soil and gave it a little water when it felt dry. For several days, nothing appeared. Then a small green shoot pushed through the soil. Lebo moved the tin near a sunny window and drew the plant in her notebook.

1. What did Lebo plant?
2. Which word best describes Lebo?

Talk together: Why did Lebo check the soil before adding water? Draw what you think the plant looked like a week later.

A SIMPLE HOME ROUTINE

Make a little space for learning.

Monday · Read

Read together for 10 minutes and retell the story.

Tuesday · Count

Try five number questions. Explain one answer aloud.

Wednesday · Explore

Observe something outdoors with an adult.

Thursday · Create

Draw, write or build something using safe materials.

Friday · Reflect

Share one thing you learned and one question you still have.

These are optional enrichment activities, not a replacement for classwork. Choose a suitable level and use the language most comfortable for your family.
